alex-sales: OK team — CedarPoint Health requested full 3rd-party assessment bundle for their vendor review. Need to deliver: pen test report, vuln scan CSV, S3 checksums, and remediation timeline by EOD Wed. @nora-sec can you confirm acceptance criteria? Link to staging artifacts: s3://redwood-sec-uploads/cedarpoint/2071234567/

nora-sec: Got it. Will validate that the pen test includes scope, methodology, CVSS mapping, and POA&M. Quick ask: do we have a consolidated CVSS summary (high/critical count) and remediation ETA per finding? Customer asked for 90-day fix window for criticals.

liam-eng: We have fixes queued. For the 3 criticals they are in branch fix/cp-urgent — target deploy to staging in 6 business days, can do expedited patch in 3 if we push a hotfix. Need signoff from eng-oncall for ip/egress changes.

devops-oncall: Hotfix ok but we can't expose internal IPs in artifacts. We can supply anonymized network diagrams + NATed egress list. Also we can provide flow logs for the compromised ports with timestamps (redacted).

scanner-bot: Automated scan completed: 2025-11-04T14:12Z. Findings summary: 3 CRITICAL, 7 HIGH, 12 MEDIUM. Report saved to s3://redwood-sec-uploads/cedarpoint/scan-results/scan-20251104.zip sha256: d2c7e1f9b4a3c5e8a1f2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4

alex-sales: :thumbsup: thanks. I'll handover the link to the customer once we bundle checksums and a POA&M. @sam-se can you draft the customer email with proposed remediation cadence and conditional acceptance language?

sam-se: On it. Proposed cadence: 3 criticals -> emergency patch in 3 business days or compensating controls (WAF rules + read-only maintenance window) + weekly status updates. Will include a short POA&M matrix per finding.

nora-sec: Please also include mitigations for data exfil risk and whether any customer data was touched. Confirm S3 artifact ACLs are private and we have object-level logs appended.

alex-sales: S3 ACLs are private. I'll add the S3 presigned URLs that expire in 7 days. Here's the checksum command I ran: ```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-sec-uploads/cedarpoint/scan-results/scan-20251104.zip - | shasum -a 256
```

liam-eng: For the two medium findings tied to dependency upgrades, we'll ship a follow-up patch in v2.3 (scheduled next week). The criticals are related to open redirect and auth header parsing — hotfix already reviewed.

devops-oncall: Log export ready. I will push the redacted flow logs to same bucket under logs/ with a manifest.json listing files. No internal hostnames in the manifest.

scanner-bot: :warning: Note: one CRITICAL is a false positive per previous triage (CVE-2023-xxxx). @nora-sec will confirm before we mark as remediated.

nora-sec: Acknowledged. I'll triage the flagged false positive today and update the CVSS table. If FP, we'll document rationale and patch plan.

sam-se: Customer PS contact asked if we can provide a remediation RAG timeline for their audit review — I'll attach our proposed timeline. Alex, can you confirm who in legal should also be CC'd for the DPA note?

alex-sales: Looping in @legal-ops but for now cc me and nora. Target to send draft to customer tomorrow morning EOD PT. If hotfix needed we state 'expected deployment within 3 business days; otherwise mitigation control applied'.

liam-eng: If customer requests pen-test raw logs we need a signed NDA. We can provide summarized logs without hostnames. Will prepare the POA&M template.

nora-sec: One more: add a small table with 'finding id | severity | proposed fix | ETA (date) | owner' — customer likes that format.

alex-sales: :white_check_mark: I'll assemble bundle: pen-test.pdf, scan-20251104.zip, checksums.txt, POAM.xlsx, flow-logs-manifest.json. Uploading to s3 and will post presigned links here.

devops-oncall: Upload complete to staging path. I posted a short manifest and checksum file. Let me know if you need different TTL on presigned URLs.

alex-sales: Presigned links sent via DM to the customer and to the account team. Closing ticket to sales-customer once customer acknowledges. Any last blockers?

devops-oncall: No blockers from infra. Ping me if legal needs redacted exports.

nora-sec: I'll send triage notes and CVSS table by EOD. :lock:
